Evidence to capture: Date/time, workflow, system/component, trigger, short description and affected users
Owner question: Can a reviewer understand what happened without searching chat threads?
Green signal: Each incident has a unique ID and plain-language summary
Stop/escalate signal: Only screenshots or informal messages exist

Evidence to capture: Business impact, customer exposure, safety/privacy/security sensitivity and operational disruption
Owner question: Was the issue internal-only customer-facing or adviser-sensitive?
Green signal: Severity rating and impact owner are documented
Stop/escalate signal: Potential customer, data or safety impact is uncertain

Evidence to capture: Who overrode the AI, what they changed, why and whether the override was approved
Owner question: Are humans correcting the system in a repeatable visible way?
Green signal: Override reason codes and reviewer are visible
Stop/escalate signal: Staff routinely bypass the AI without logging why

Evidence to capture: Prompt, retrieval, model, data, integration, policy, access or process cause hypothesis
Owner question: Is the cause known enough to prevent recurrence?
Green signal: Cause hypothesis has evidence and remediation owner
Stop/escalate signal: Repeat issues are labelled user error or ignored

Evidence to capture: Rollback trigger, temporary controls, affected feature restriction and owner approval
Owner question: Did the team know when to stop or restrict use?
Green signal: Rollback criteria are linked to incident severity
Stop/escalate signal: No one knows who can pause the pilot

Evidence to capture: Sales, marketing, customer-support or board wording affected by the incident
Owner question: Do public or buyer-facing claims still match evidence?
Green signal: Claims are paused narrowed or supported by fresh evidence
Stop/escalate signal: The team keeps saying safe accurate ready after contrary incidents

Evidence to capture: Fix evidence, test result, review signer, residual risk and next scale decision
Owner question: Can leadership decide continue restrict remediate or roll back?
Green signal: Closure includes evidence and decision owner
Stop/escalate signal: Incident is closed because the alert disappeared
